ns2:section.sectionText: ON-CAMPUS PROGRAM UNDERGRADUATE STUDENTS SECTION B. Asynchronous online. No synchronous class meeting time/day. Canvas LMS. Enrollment Restrictions Notation: No late adds after start of first class without prior written permission of the professor at bmbarnet@illinois.edu. Cross listed with HDFS 424 and AFRO 421. No non-degree enrollments. Restricted to Juniors and Seniors with degree status for 3 hours credit. Not for students with Undergraduate Non-Degree, Graduate Non-Degree, Audits, Sit-ins, Credit/No Credit, Freshman, Sophomore class standing.
